ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (18) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Себялюбие» (sebyalyubie, 'self-love') is kept as 'self-love' throughout (the website draft varied it with 'selfishness'); «самоотречение» (samootrechenie) is 'self-renunciation', «самоотвержение» (samootverzhenie) 'self-denial', and «самопожертвование» (samopozhertvovanie) 'self-sacrifice'. In the fifth thought the printed «не только» (ne tol'ko, 'not only') seems to run against the sense and is translated as printed.

Source observation: [15] «благу, которое не только в отречении от себя и в служении другим» ('their good, which is not only in renunciation of self and in service to others') reads against the sense (the good lies only in self-renunciation); possibly a stray «не» (ne, 'not'); translated as printed
